messages:
maria_support: Customer AcmeCorp (org_id=org_6421) just escalated — their org-level latency dashboard shows p50 but p95/p99 lines are missing after this morning's rollout. They attached a screenshot and said it's blocking incident RCA. Seen first at ~09:12 UTC. Ticket #7892. Can someone take ownership?

deploy-bot: canary rollout completed: proxy-service v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2 @ 09:05 UTC

ken_sre: I'll take it. maria, can you paste the console URL and a screenshot link? Is it org-scoped panels only or global dashboards too?

maria_support: url: https://console.redwood.dev/analytics/latency?org=org_6421
Only org-level latency panels (SLO and per-route panels still show p95/p99). Customer says the tails are gone from the org view specifically. Screenshot: https://acmecorp.attached/snap1.png

priya_platform: I noticed an alert earlier in staging after we merged the metric-tag-normalize change — we started renaming histogram labels during org aggregation. Might be related: aggregator now rewrites quantile series label to `q` and console expects `quantile`. @ken_sre can you check the aggregation transform?

ken_sre: query check: run this against TSDB: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{org="org_6421"}[5m])) by (le))
```
For affected org it returns empty. But raw counters exist: `request_duration_sum{org="org_6421"}` returns values. So buckets might be getting dropped or their `le` labels removed.

jake_runtime: We shipped a small proxy change that strips repeated labels to reduce cardinality. It was supposed to drop only `env` in certain cases, but the implementation used a wildcard and could remove `le` in grouped histograms if org tag present. Rolling back to evaluate.

maria_support: Customer needs ETA — they're seeing missing percentiles in workspace view and are worried SLA alerts might be wrong.

ken_sre: ETA 45m to push hotfix to canary to preserve `le` and `quantile` labels during org aggregation. Will validate on a test org first.

priya_platform: Also adding a UI fallback to compute percentiles from raw histograms if series naming doesn't match expected pattern — task PLAT-832.

olivia_cs: Please post status updates I can forward to AcmeCorp.

maria_support: Message to customer sent: "Investigating, suspected metrics transform regression after deploy. ETA ~45m for a fix on canary, will update." :hourglass: 

deploy-bot: rollback job started for proxy-service on canary (job id rb-2026-631)

ken_sre: Hotfix applied to canary aggregator: tagging change reverted. Re-ran the histogram_quantile test — now returns values for a test org. Spinning canary validation for 10m.

maria_support: AcmeCorp reports they can see p95/p99 returning in their org dashboard now — confirming for prod?

ken_sre: Pushing fix to prod rollout; will monitor.

deploy-bot: prod rollout started for proxy-service v2.3.1 (rollback)

support-bot: incident created: INC-2026-412 (Latency percentiles missing in org view). Severity: P2.

ken_sre: Prod metrics look healthy. p95/p99 lines have reappeared for org_6421. Will keep monitoring for 60m then close. Root cause: a greedy label-strip in the metrics aggregator removed histogram `le` label when org tag was present; console expects standard histogram/quantile semantics. Fix: tighten label-filter and add unit test. PR #459 linked in infra repo.

priya_platform: Filed follow-up to console: add tolerant parsing of quantile series and a fallback to recompute percentiles from buckets if label mismatch detected (PLAT-832).

olivia_cs: Updated customer with resolution and ETA for permanent preventive fix. They acknowledged, thanks.

maria_support: Closing ticket #7892 after customer confirmation. Thanks everyone. :tada:
